description: EOFY sale hero creative — hyperreal excavator peeling turf to reveal 'EOFY SALE ON NOW!' carved in the dirt. Low-res 1K draft for sign-off, then we go HQ + other dimensions.

frames.prompt:
Hyperreal cinematic promotional photograph, 1:1 square composition. Surreal-but-photoreal — every texture believable, lit like a paid editorial shoot.

[Context] EOFY Sale hero creative for the DiggerLid earthmoving brand. The visual metaphor: a yellow excavator's bucket peeling back a section of green grass turf like a thick living carpet, revealing rich brown earth beneath — and carved/dug into that revealed dirt is the message 'EOFY SALE ON NOW!'.

[Visual] CENTRE-FRAME HERO ACTION: a heavy steel excavator BUCKET and the lower section of the boom enter from the UPPER-RIGHT of the frame at a dramatic three-quarter angle, yellow industrial paint job on the boom (a warm earthmover yellow, distinctly different from the DiggerLid brand yellow), bright chrome hydraulic ram visible alongside. The bucket's teeth GRIP the leading edge of a thick slab of grass turf — bright living green grass on top, dense soil-and-root sub-layer underneath visible as the turf curls upward and back over the bucket like a peeled rug. The peeled turf shows its undersides — tangled white root mat, dark loam.

BELOW the peeled turf, dominating the LOWER TWO-THIRDS of the frame: rich, deep, textured dark-brown earth filling the ground plane. Scattered clods of dirt, broken chunks, small pebbles, freshly-dug clay. The earth surface CARVED with massive integrated typography reading EXACTLY 'EOFY SALE / ON NOW!' on TWO LINES — top line 'EOFY SALE' in heavy bold uppercase block-serif lettering (think dimensional carved-out letterforms), bottom line 'ON NOW!' in a flowing energetic cursive script. The letterforms are part of the earth — raised dirt-clod relief OR recessed grooves, edges crumbly with loose soil, deep shadow inside the strokes, warm raking sunlight catching the upper edges. The text reads instantly as 'made of dirt'. Zero typos, no missing characters, no extra letters.

BACKGROUND: receding ground plane with another silhouetted earthmoving machine in the distance on the right horizon, dramatic GOLDEN-HOUR SKY filling the upper third — saturated warm oranges, pinks, and amber clouds, soft volumetric haze, sun-flare glint suggested at the horizon.

FRAME BORDER: A clean THIN DiggerLid brand-yellow border (#e9de15) wrapping the ENTIRE square edge of the image — uniform thickness all four sides, roughly 1% of the frame width, sharp clean line, no fade, no gradient, the border sits on top of the image as a finished frame.

[Format] 1:1 square. 1K low-res draft for review.

[Style] Hyperreal cinematic editorial photograph, dramatic golden-hour lighting, rich earth tones, surreal-but-believable composition. Heavy hyperreal texture detail on the grass, roots, soil, and bucket. Premium production-still quality. The only text in the image is the 'EOFY SALE / ON NOW!' carved into the dirt — no other words, no captions, no logo wordmark anywhere else.

[Context] EOFY Sale hero creative for the DiggerLid earthmoving brand. A KUBOTA U17-3 orange compact mini-excavator caught mid-DIGGING action, its bucket scooping into rich dark earth — and the very act of digging REVEALS the message 'EOFY SALE / ON NOW!' carved into the freshly-exposed dirt.

[Visual — Machine] CENTRE-RIGHT of frame: a KUBOTA U17-3 compact mini-excavator in distinctive KUBOTA ORANGE paintwork, the small 1.7-tonne class. Open ROPS canopy frame above the operator seat (NO enclosed cab — just a roof on tubular grey support posts), the operator's seat visible underneath. Rubber tracks, small dozer blade at the front. Curved articulating boom in orange with a black hydraulic ram alongside. Black KUBOTA logo decal on the side of the boom. The machine is angled at three-quarter facing forward-left, body weight balanced on its tracks. NO operator visible in the seat (or just suggested).

[Visual — Action] The bucket arm is EXTENDED forward and DOWN, the toothed bucket actively CURLING into the dirt — mid-scoop motion, NOT lifting turf. The leading edge of the steel bucket teeth is half-buried in the soil with fresh dirt cascading off the back of the bucket as it scoops. Dirt clods FLYING outward in a small fan from the action point. A scattered scrape-line of disturbed earth radiating from where the bucket bites in. The dig action is the energy of the frame.

[Visual — Text Reveal] In the FRESHLY-DUG, freshly-exposed dark-brown earth carved across the LOWER LEFT TWO-THIRDS of the frame, the bucket's action has REVEALED massive integrated typography reading EXACTLY on TWO LINES:
  LINE 1: 'EOFY SALE'
  LINE 2: 'ON NOW!'
rendered in BAHNSCHRIFT BOLD style — a heavy condensed industrial German-influenced sans-serif, sharp geometric strokes, bold weight, tight letter-spacing. The letterforms appear DUG INTO and RAISED FROM the soil — dirt-clod relief, edges crumbly with loose earth, deep shadow inside the strokes, warm raking sunlight catching the upper edges. The text is part of the earth itself, dirt-textured but legible. Zero typos, no missing characters.

DIRECTLY BELOW the main text, a smaller secondary line in the SAME Bahnschrift Bold condensed sans-serif but at roughly 30% the size, also dirt-carved: 'BE QUICK — ENDS JUNE 30'. Renders cleanly with no typos.

[Visual — Background] The ground plane recedes into a worksite middle ground. UPPER THIRD of frame: dramatic GOLDEN-HOUR SKY in warm oranges, ambers, and soft pinks, low warm sun, subtle volumetric haze. A distant silhouette of another piece of earthmoving equipment at the far right horizon.

[Format] 1:1 square, edge-to-edge full-bleed (NO border in the image — added in post).

[Context] DiggerLid EOFY Sale hero creative. Three-zone composition: digger action up top, hero text in the middle, buried products along the bottom.

[TOP THIRD — DIGGER ACTION] Top ~33% of the frame. From the upper-right, the orange toothed BUCKET and lower section of the dipper ARM of a KUBOTA U17-3 compact mini-excavator (Kubota industrial orange paint, black KUBOTA decal on the boom, chrome hydraulic ram) reaches down INTO the top of the frame. The bucket is mid-action, TIPPING / DROPPING a cascade of loose dark-brown DIRT downward — a falling sheet of soil and chunky clods raining vertically down out of the bucket onto the middle third of the frame. Dust trail in the air, motion-blur on the falling dirt. The action: dirt being deposited ONTO the text below. The arm and bucket are in golden-hour sidelight from upper-left. NO operator visible.

[MIDDLE THIRD — HERO TEXT] Middle ~33% of the frame. Carved into rich, deep, textured dark-brown EARTH that fills this horizontal band, massive dirt-carved typography on THREE LINES, all in BAHNSCHRIFT BOLD style (heavy condensed industrial sans-serif, sharp geometric strokes, tight letter-spacing, all uppercase). The three lines stack tightly, vertically centred in the band, edge-to-edge wide:
  LINE 1: 'DIGGERLID EOFY SALE'  (the widest line — fills the horizontal width of the band)
  LINE 2: 'ON NOW'                (largest weight, biggest visual punch — slightly bigger than L1, centred)
  LINE 3: 'GET IN QUICK — ENDS JUNE 30'  (smaller — roughly 40% the cap-height of L1, centred)
All three lines are RAISED dirt-relief carved into the soil — dirt-clod texture, crumbly edges, deep shadow inside the strokes, warm raking sidelight catching the upper edges. The text is part of the earth itself. Zero typos, no missing characters, no extra letters. Some loose dirt from the cascade above is just starting to land on the top edge of LINE 1.

[BOTTOM THIRD — BURIED PRODUCTS ROW] Bottom ~33% of the frame. THREE DiggerLid products laid out in a LOOSE HORIZONTAL ROW across the bottom band, each partially BURIED in the dirt of the ground plane — like uncovered artefacts at a dig. From LEFT to RIGHT:
  • LEFT product (~25% from left edge): the DiggerLid HAULER BAG (heavy-duty grey/black ballistic-fabric wheeled duffel, large diagonal 'DiggerLid' wordmark with yellow accents, black webbing straps with yellow stitched bartacks) — lying on its side at an angle, half-buried, only the upper portion visible above the dirt, the wordmark partly readable through dust.
  • CENTRE product (~50%): the DiggerLid DRAWBAR COVER (small fitted grey PVC trailer-drawbar cover with black trim) — half-buried in a mound of dirt, dust-coated.
  • RIGHT product (~75%): the DiggerLid DRINK / TOOL CADDY (small grey pouch with white DiggerLid wordmark + yellow accent line, holding a black drink bottle in the top compartment and a chrome STANLEY FatMax tape measure in the lower compartment) — half-buried, the wordmark catching the light.
Each product is preserved EXACTLY in silhouette / fabric / hardware / branding per the reference images attached. All three are dust-coated to belong in the dirt scene, but DiggerLid branding still pops. The row is loosely arranged, not rigidly aligned — natural staggered heights.

[Style] Hyperreal cinematic editorial photograph, dramatic golden-hour raking sidelight from upper-left, rich earth tones, surreal-but-believable composition. The ONLY text in the image is the three dirt-carved lines plus the natural printed DiggerLid wordmarks on the buried products. NO captions, NO border lines, NO sky visible.
